contact_objects.name: nail_proxy
contact_objects.description: Defined fixed nail contact proxy, not a measured real nail. XY lies in the recorded strike footprint. Top z=0.844296m is 2mm above the lowest hammer mesh surface in that footprint during 8-12s of the rebased trajectory (area-weighted surface sampling, seed61, 140000 points). The fixed collider also loads later strokes; it does not model a nail sinking into material.
